IncidentDef.label: Tok'ra intercepted threat
IncidentDef.letterText: A Tok'ra cell has intercepted Goa'uld/Jaffa movements converging toward your region. The force is not visible from the colony yet, but the channel estimates contact {ARRIVALWINDOW}. Probable signature: {SIGNATURE}. The Tok'ra will not send troops or supplies, but the tactical assessment channel may reveal more before the attack reaches you.
